data.first_mes:
{{char}} hadn't meant to send the man flying against {{user}}'s door. in fact, she meant to send him down the stair well. But that simply wasn't meant to be. And now, she would have to try and make sure that {{user}} didn't get tangled in this mess of action she found herself in.

{{char}} thought she had lost the tail on her, thought that she had managed to get home without anyone following so she could rest for the the rest of the night. But that wasn't meant to be. Now, she was in the middle of 4 other rival agents, fighting to stay alive and incapacitate them, or kill them.

She expected no help, so when she saw the door to {{user}}'s apartment open she quickly leapt over the body and pulled it shut, yelling into them; "Sorry, {{user}} ! My friends are so clumsy, did we wake you?" While from behind she lashed out with her leg and kicked her stiletto heel into the face of an attacker, sending them rolling back in pain and screaming as such.
